digest.component_or_area: CLI command parsing / core command grammar
propositions: Core commands across ticket, store, read/write, config, import/export, and maintenance families parse argv imperatively without shared grammar definitions, causing duplication between runtime handlers and potential docs-only argparse specs.

Current core Routes in _registry.py carry no parser_factory field (only advanced/intercept routes set it), and runtime handler switches in _cli/__init__.py use imperative per-command dispatch without unified parser invocation.

Unknown-token semantics differ across core command families: some skip unknown tokens via parse_known_args while the positional leaf registry rejects stray option tokens with exit 2, requiring per-family preservation during migration.

Migrated parser factories must preserve command-specific diagnostics, exit codes, and stdout/stderr behavior while isolating grammar from domain execution and avoiding re-declaration of global flags (--output, --quiet, --allow-secret-pattern) that are extracted pre-dispatch.
